name: Autonomous AI Research Agent - Ollama + Tavily + Memory

parameters.jsCode: const a=$input.first().json; const sources=Array.isArray(a.sources)?a.sources:[]; const urls=sources.slice(0,5).map(s=>s.url).filter(Boolean); if(!urls.length) throw new Error('No URLs available for webpage extraction.'); return [{json:{sources,sourceCount:a.sourceCount,failedSearches:a.failedSearches||[],urls}}];

const response=$input.first().json??{}; const base=$('Prepare URLs for Webpage Extraction').first().json; const extracted=Array.isArray(response.results)?response.results:(Array.isArray(response.body?.results)?response.body.results:[]); const byUrl=new Map(extracted.map(r=>[String(r.url||'').trim(),r])); const failed=Array.isArray(response.failed_results)?response.failed_results:(Array.isArray(response.body?.failed_results)?response.body.failed_results:[]); const sources=(base.sources||[]).map(s=>{const full=byUrl.get(String(s.url||'').trim()); return {...s,content:String(full?.raw_content||full?.content||s.content||'').slice(0,1800),extractionStatus:full?'extracted':'search_snippet_fallback'};}); return [{json:{sources,sourceCount:base.sourceCount,failedSearches:base.failedSearches||[],extractionFailures:failed,extractedCount:sources.filter(s=>s.extractionStatus==='extracted').length}}];

const final=$('Research Quality Check').first().json; const write=$input.first()?.json??{}; return [{json:{...final,memory:{table:'ResearchMemory',saved:!write.error,note:write.error?'Memory write did not complete; check the ResearchMemory table and columns.':'Research run stored for future context.'}}}];
